name: "No"-Oriented Questioning
stage: De-escalation, Resistance Defusal & Countering Bad Faith
scenario: Re-engaging an enterprise prospective customer who has gone completely silent after receiving a proposal.
script: "Have you completely given up on this integration project for this fiscal year?"
defense: Answer directly: no, the initiative is not abandoned; capital priority moved to data migration, re-engagement in Q3.
originFull: Autonomy Preservation and Psychological Reactance establish that saying "Yes" triggers defensiveness and fear of commitment, whereas saying "No" provides a psychological shield of control and safety.
defenseFull: When targeted with a "No"-oriented inquiry: "No, we have not abandoned the initiative, but our capital priority has shifted toward enterprise data migration. We will re-engage in Q3."
